description: The jobs the extension worked on for the user, newest first, with each one's status, where the job came from and the outcome the user reported. status is the extension's: submitted means the site confirmed it; unconfirmed means it was sent or may have been, with no confirmation; sent means the user sent it with the site's own button and the site didn't confirm it. Never call unconfirmed or sent submitted. outcome is only what the user marked (interview, offer, rejected, no_reply) and null when they haven't; never treat silence as no reply. Needs the user's personal access token.
name: list_auto_apply_history

outcome.description: What the user reported after applying, or null.

source.description: Where the job was first added from: the board, an alert, an AI assistant (mcp), the extension, auto apply's own matches or other. null for jobs added before 28 October 2026.

sources.description: Every place that tried to add this job, first one first, each with when.

title: List auto apply history
